Occurrence Remarks: The colour palette is mostly initial periderm (older/outer bark), with some colouring from lichens. The bark is from a mature tree at least 35 years old. Even at this age, a Rosy Brown hue is present (something more common in the younger active periderm). I had failed to notice the Rosy Brown until the colour palette drew my attention to it. The Rosy Brown hue is present in the top half of the image and complimented by Mountbatten Pink (or the left side of the source image in landscape mode).The ten most dominate colours in the bark are listed on the left. The source image was in 8bit colour with an sRGB colour profile embedded.It is a visual colour palette of the main colours in the bark, it is not scientifically exact.Colour names based the hexadecimal RGB colour code: https://www.99colors.net/color-namesSource image attached.
